61a1ce95aedac633fcd1f0f977051283c7b20148.note: Successor review for flopstyle-dark under run flopstyle-dark-successor-20261030-m123 (candidate set a2545305, candidate 4e9f17d1 with the V2b Firefox container anchoring). I compared the frozen EN source renderings at all five widths against the successor captures and reviewed every screenshot row of the new audit directly (91 frames viewed first-hand in labeled montages; 20 byte-identical frames carry the closure audit's verdicts). Preserved in every layout: the dark slate ground with magenta masthead and accents, the contained top bar at desktop, mobile and narrow-mobile, the sidebar and page-action surfaces, the credit bar and dialogs, and the rating module placement. The Firefox top-bar endpoint submenus that escaped before the fix are contained in the new Firefox captures, and the Chromium and WebKit geometry is unchanged. Documented localization differences only: JP fixture content and glyphs replace the EN text.
